actions.eval: (() => { const m = document.querySelector('main') ?? document.body; return m.innerText.slice(0, 1400) })()

(() => { const m = document.querySelector('main') ?? document.body; const t = m.innerText; return { text: t.slice(0, 2400), notSetUp: t.split('\n').filter(l => /not set up|not configured|No ENS|UNWRITTEN_|No ledger|ledger/i.test(l)), errors: t.split('\n').filter(l => /^Error · /.test(l)) } })()

(() => { const m = document.querySelector('main') ?? document.body; const t = m.innerText; return { text: t.slice(0, 2400), notSetUp: t.split('\n').filter(l => /not set up|not configured|No ENS|UNWRITTEN_|read-only|station/i.test(l)), errors: t.split('\n').filter(l => /^Error · /.test(l)) } })()

(() => { const d = document.querySelector('[role=dialog]'); if (!d) return 'no dialog'; const t = d.innerText; return { sections: [...d.querySelectorAll('section')].map(s => s.innerText.split('\n')[0].trim()), errors: t.split('\n').filter(l => /^Error · /.test(l)), sharedWorlds: (() => { const s = [...d.querySelectorAll('section')].find(x => x.innerText.startsWith('Shared worlds')); return s ? s.innerText.slice(0, 500) : null })() } })()

(() => { const errs = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog] *')].filter(e => /^Error · /.test((e.innerText ?? '').trim()) && e.children.length === 0).map(e => e.parentElement?.innerText ?? e.innerText); return errs })()
(() => { const s = [...document.querySelectorAll('section')].find(x => x.innerText.startsWith('Shared worlds')); s?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); return !!s })()
